name: Hero Rally
description: An event with level rewards. You can buy a pack for more items and buy levels for 2,160 gems each.

rewards.name: Level rewards
rewards.note: Shown on the wiki only as screenshots. Each extra level costs 2,160 gems.

tips: The wiki gives no reward amounts as text.
The event screen shows level progress such as Lv. 1 with 0 of 90 points, and a Purchase Level button.
